title: AuditKIT：面向大语言模型与智能体系统评测、评判与比较的统一评估框架
summary: AuditKIT 是一个开源评估库，将基准准确率、评判模型评估、运行时性能、工具调用行为和检索质量统一到同一结果表示中，支持方向感知的指标契约、配置指纹和可扩展后端。针对智能体，它提供轮次感知的工具调用匹配，区分并行与串行执行，并将缺失证据标记为未评分而非失败。
summary_en: AuditKIT is a source-available evaluation library that unifies benchmark accuracy, judge-based assessment, runtime performance, tool-use behavior, and retrieval quality in one result representation, with direction-aware metric contracts, configuration fingerprints, and extensible backends. For agents, it offers turn-aware tool-call matching, separates parallel from sequential execution, and marks missing evidence as unscored rather than failure.
